correctness.rationale: Using explicit labeled degree-5 icosahedron, its 12x12 distance matrix has exactly six antipodal pairs with d(x,anti(a))=3-d(x,a). Equidistant witnesses to any nonantipodal vertex pair lie in precisely two antipodal blocks; no <=2 landmarks resolve. Therefore exactly C(6,3)2³=160 triples from distinct antipodal blocks resolve, rank-three partition-matroid truncation. Independently enumerated all C(12,3)=220 candidates, both 160-state slide and jump graphs, all 12720 unordered basis pairs, and all 6 transport bijections. Slide graph 9-regular, 720 edges, ecc {4:20,5:120,6:20}; jump 21-regular and diameter three; transport gap distribution 12110 zero and 610 one, none >one. This is exhaustive integer proof for one fixed graph; no infinite generalization.
